overview.pillarsTitle: The three parts of your pension
overview.pillarsDesc: Your future pension is built from three pillars. By making active choices in the premiepension and occupational pension, you can influence how much you'll receive.
overview.pillar1Desc: Inkomstpension (16%) + premiepension (2.5%). You can choose funds for the premiepension portion via Pensionsmyndigheten.
overview.pillar2Desc: Your employer pays in. ITP1 (defined contribution) or ITP2 (defined benefit). You typically choose how the money is invested via Collectum.
overview.pillar3Desc: ISK, capital insurance, shares, funds. What you save yourself beyond the pension. Needed to maintain your standard of living.
overview.agePortfoliosSubtitle: Pension saving is about the time horizon. The more time you have left, the more risk you can take.
overview.keyInsightTitle: 💡 The most important thing to remember
overview.keyInsight1: State pension + occupational pension often provide only 50–60% of your final salary
overview.keyInsight2: The fee is the single most important factor — 0.2% vs 1.5% can mean millions
overview.keyInsight3: AP7 Såfa outperforms most active funds over the long term
overview.keyInsight4: Make your ITP choice — the default (Alecta traditional) is rarely optimal for young people

models.youngSuggestion: AP7 Såfa or 100% global index fund
models.youngDetail: Long horizon — maximise growth. Downturns have time to recover.
models.midCareerDetail: Start reducing risk. Keep growth focus but protect a portion.
models.nearRetirementDetail: Prioritise capital protection. Less time to recover from downturns.
models.retireeDetail: Focus on stability and regular payouts.

ppmFunds.ap7EquityNote: The state's default choice. Very low fee, global equity exposure with leverage.
ppmFunds.ap7BondNote: The state's bond fund. Low risk, fixed income.

ppm.title: Premiepension
ppm.desc: 2.5% of your pensionable income goes to the premiepension. You choose from funds on the Pensionsmyndigheten fund marketplace.
ppm.ap7Title: 📊 AP7 Såfa — the state's default choice
ppm.ap7Desc: If you don't make an active choice, everything is placed in AP7 Såfa — a generation fund with a 0.05% fee that automatically reduces the equity share from age 55. Historical return: approx. 10–12% per year since inception. Hard to beat by most active funds.
ppm.fundsDisclaimer: The funds above are available on the Pensionsmyndigheten fund marketplace. Fees may have changed.
ppm.step1: Log in to pensionsmyndigheten.se or minpension.se with BankID
ppm.step3: Search for funds — prioritise low fees and broad index
ppm.step4: Confirm the switch — completed within 2–3 banking days
ppm.mistake1: Choosing funds with fees over 1% — eats into your pension
ppm.mistake2: Switching funds frequently — timing rarely works, costs in out-of-market days
ppm.mistake3: Forgetting your choice — check once a year that the fund still works for you
ppm.mistake4: Believing active management beats the index — 80–90% of active funds underperform over 10+ years

itp.title: Occupational pension — ITP
itp.itp1Bullet1: 4.5% on salary up to 7.5 income base amounts
itp.itp1Bullet2: 30% on salary above 7.5 income base amounts
itp.itp1Bullet3: You choose how the money is invested
itp.itp1Bullet4: The final amount depends entirely on returns + fees
itp.itp2Bullet1: Guaranteed pension as a share of your final salary
itp.itp2Bullet2: 10% of salary up to 7.5 income base amounts
itp.itp2Bullet4: The ITPK portion (2%) you can choose placement for
itp.unitLinkedBullet3: No guarantee — you bear the risk
itp.warningDesc: Without an active choice, your ITP1 pension ends up in traditional insurance with Alecta. As a young person with 30+ years left, unit-linked insurance can deliver significantly more.
itp.providersDesc: You choose provider and investment type at collectum.se with BankID.
itp.howTitle: How to make your ITP choice
itp.howStep1: Log in to collectum.se with BankID
itp.howStep2: Choose insurance provider (e.g. Avanza Pension, Nordnet, AMF)
itp.howStep3: Choose unit-linked insurance if you're under ~55
itp.howStep4: Choose global index funds with fees below 0.3%
itp.howStep5: Suggested allocation: 70% global equity index, 20% Sweden index, 10% bond fund
itp.summaryLine1Desc: Choose unit-linked insurance with global index funds if you have 15+ years left
itp.summaryLine2Desc: Same logic — index funds with low fees
itp.summaryLine3Desc: 0.2% vs 1.5% can mean hundreds of thousands of kronor
